name: Gardenia
source:
A witch with more knowledge than a library could hold. A mysterious, yet easy quest leads Viola's party to her shack where Gardenia confronts the girls with a surprise: she knows about Japan and who summoned the girls into their favorite game. 

[from official twitter page]
